 Ebola medics dance as last patients at Democratic Republic of Congo facility are discharged
 Democratic Republic of Congo
 Ebola
 Médecins Sans Frontières
 Mongbwalu
 Health workers at an Ebola treatment centre in the Democratic Republic of Congo celebrated after the final patients were discharged from the facility in Mongbwalu, the historic epicentre of the outbreak.
 Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) said the centre in Ituri has no confirmed cases in beds for the first time since the Ebola outbreak was declared in May.
